For over a decade, nearly every hospital named to the Best Children’s Hospitals Honor Roll has relied on Spok to support communication across complex care environments.

“We are proud to recognize these outstanding children’s hospitals and the clinicians and staff who provide exceptional care to children and their families,” said Vincent D. Kelly, chief executive officer of Spok Holdings, Inc. “Having every hospital honored on this year’s list as a Spok customer is particularly meaningful. Our communication solutions help their teams stay connected and coordinated, delivering secure and reliable communication when it matters most.”

U.S. News & World Report, the global authority in hospital rankings, has published its Best Children’s Hospitals list since 2007. The 2026-2027 edition marks the 20th annual Best Children's Hospitals ranking. This year, 114 hospitals and thousands of pediatric specialists were surveyed across 11 specialties, including pediatric cancer, cardiology and heart surgery, orthopedics, and more. In total, 90 hospitals earned rankings in at least one specialty, with 11 earning top honors on the 2026–2027 Best Children’s Hospitals Honor Roll.

Spok, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Spok Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: SPOK), headquartered in Plano, Texas, is proud to be a global leader in healthcare communications. We deliver clinical information to care teams when and where it matters most to improve patient outcomes. Top hospitals rely on the Spok Care Connect® platform to enhance workflows for clinicians and support administrative compliance. Our customers send approximately 70 million messages each month through their Spok® solutions. Spok enables smarter, faster clinical communication. For more information, visit spok.com.
